title: 2004 Disneyland Resort 8" Vampire Mickey Mouse Halloween Parks Exclusive Disney
descriptionText: The product is an 8" plush toy of Vampire Mickey Mouse from the Disney franchise, specifically created as an exclusive Halloween Parks item for the Disneyland Resort in 2004. This collectible item showcases the iconic character Mickey Mouse with a Halloween twist, making it a unique and sought-after piece for Disney enthusiasts and collectors alike.
